body:
Central capacity rule, extending central-cargo-memory-budget-2026-11-05, whose body is at its size limit (Opus2, 2026-11-14 17:36Z; incident w-e938ef8d73be, Fable2 #6187).

INCIDENT: Central's TermAl host aborted (0xc0000409) after "memory allocation of 2719744 bytes failed" at 17:08:27Z, about 69 s into the rust stage of Merger's Engram FULL test-5fd78553. That FULL was launched at FV 30,972,320 KiB with no rustc, and nothing else heavy was running.

CAUSE: FULL launchers pass NO -j. Engram's rust stage (scripts/test-rust.ps1, then cargo test) defaulted to 24 jobs (Central has 24 logical CPUs) while linking 35 integration-test binaries plus the lib test, so up to 24 concurrent rustc/link.exe processes mapped the fresh libengram rlib. rust.log shows "os error 1455 paging file too small" and "LNK1102 out of memory". Commit limit is about 87.4 GiB (63.4 GiB physical + 24 GiB pagefile).
Every FV floor assumed an explicit -j1 or -j2; for an unbounded FULL it was meaningless.

RULES:
A. NO cargo on Central without bounded jobs: either an explicit -j, or CARGO_BUILD_JOBS set in the environment of the launcher process. That covers every launcher full or focused run; cargo honours CARGO_BUILD_JOBS in every stage.
B. A FULL launcher run on Central (TermAl or Engram) launches with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 and ENGRAM_TEST_THREADS (Engram) or RUST_TEST_THREADS (TermAl) at most 4. It is COLD unless the budget memory's warm condition holds: FV at least 25,165,824 KiB, no other rustc. LLM spawns are PAUSED from START to END, and nothing else heavy runs.
C. A GO for a launcher run on Central names these environment settings explicitly. The run's START report quotes them, with its census.
D. If a launcher stage would invoke cargo without -j while CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is unset, do NOT launch on Central.
Criterion 3 of w-e938 (the host aborting on a failed allocation) is filed separately.
